segments.text: V. 26. Our LORD does not ſatisfy their Curioſity, but corrects the wrong Motive they had in ſeeking Him: Becauſe ye did eat— Merely for temporal Advantage. Hitherto Chriſt had been gathering Hearers: He now begins to try their Sincerity, by a figurative Diſcourſe concerning his Paſſion, and the Fruit of it, to be received by Faith.
